# Shaggy bestiary

Shaggy, human-faced cats and dogs and a rabbit lutenist painted in the manner of a medieval bestiary, AI-generated by adrian729 from style references; the companion set of the illuminated acanthus for the Polyhymnia app.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `shaggy-bestiary`, authored, 17 assets.
